scope: Four selectedTRAIN-root transport/data-boundary preflight,8PUCT/64teacher nodes. Reused subset of full diagnostic with different work, no independent benefit estimate or automatic training trigger.
limitations: No actual hidden assignment, opponent-private capture identity or completed game seed enters neural or native inference.
Existing source PUCT dynamics and sampled world estimates remain approximate; native-terminal prefix membership does not certify counterfactual search rules.
Native/source full legal sets checked at each selected root; incompatible roots quarantined, never silently substituted or reset to a current FEN.
Teacher query replays complete actor-specific tokens with only lawful moved reveals and captor-known private events; clears hash for each forced action.

The full diagnostic requests2048nodes per action (this transport preflight requests64) yields scores of different completed depths; the score proxy tanh(cp/860) or sign(mate) is not calibrated value, equilibrium regret or an equal-wall-time strength test.
Sharper targets or better teacher proxy do not establish better self-play or playing strength. Even positive primary evidence only supports a separately frozen controlled learning study.
One model,32reused TRAIN roots and descriptive phase sampling; no independent test generalization or multiple-comparison guarantee.
